{{Top|leg}}
The '''Naboo Essentials Provider''' was a branch of the government of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] that was responsible for maintaining the power grid which supplied electricity and energy to the entire planet. It was overseen by the [[Director of Essentials]].<ref name="Death on Naboo">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Death on Naboo]]''</ref>
